# EventSpec v4 contract fixture

`mmg_013_contract_extension.json` is a deterministic test fixture derived from the
exact validated `mmg_013` EventSpec v3 bytes. Its appended Sit, Stand, PickUp, and Pour
sequence exists only to exercise the v4 contract. It binds the exact R18 typed-scene
profile and uses that profile's water jug and drinking glass as the two Pour identities.

It is not a verified VISTA action sequence, original-action replay, UE runtime receipt,
animation acceptance result, or visual-quality claim.
